review_method: Manually read all thirty real case outputs, actual SDK messages/diagnostics, dispatch order and extraction outputs; numeric presence is not the semantic verdict

normal_answer_semantics.failures: three memory_and_tool replies offer an alternative unit despite a recalled Celsius preference; their genuine extraction tasks also fail closed

hard_failures: all three required parallel cases were actually serial
three memory/tool completion jobs failed after invalid re-emission of an existing source
harness_defects: deletion contract incorrectly required an immediate limited reply, though established P15 rebuild contract and existing regression explicitly permit a fresh tool-free generation
test called JobStore.current on a cancelled admission without an id; record admission status and distinguish actual safe rebuild
last server error overwrote earlier case errors; retain per-case error summaries
additional_B03_issue: Actual extractor accepted some tool lookup requests as durable fact proposals and the provenance validator allowed them; these are genuine source quotes but inappropriate durable memories. Full B03 quality remains unaccepted.
changes_after_review: Only CI harness/fixture expectation and diagnostic reporting; no runtime persona, retrieval, source validator or reply module changes; serial/Worker gates retained; no same-source rerun to obtain a lucky result
